kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic اِنْتِقَاء (intiqāʔ)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic انتقائي
From اِنْتِقَاء (intiqāʔ, “selection”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
Relative noun (nisba) composed of اِنْتِقَاء (intiqāʔ) + ـِيَّة (-iyya).
